summary: The filing reports the closing of a private placement of $200M 7.00% senior unsecured notes due 2031 by North American Construction Group Ltd. The proceeds will repay credit facility debt and for general corporate purposes. The offering was underwritten by a syndicate led by National Bank Financial. This is a routine debt capital markets transaction, not a special situation. Under Canadian private placement rules (equivalent to US Rule 144A/Reg S), no shareholder vote or regulatory approval was required. No risk-arb angle; watch refinancing impact on leverage.
